corrections.reason: The proposal records the answers to Q1 to Q13 as owner answers accepting the proposed resolutions, under 'Owner answers'; the alternatives remain as options considered; no question remains open. Acceptance criteria are unchanged.

derived.reason: The story lists the plan attributes but not the copy around them (choose action, chosen and recommended texts, price labels, messages); the engineering reference requires all user-facing copy to come from Strapi except the fallback, as AC-008 already does for the form steps.

The story bases the final price on step 1 data without saying what leaves the browser; principles P4 and P5, the engineering reference (personal data is not logged) and AC-026 require the minimum: derived ages only, nothing stored or logged by the stateless endpoint.
The story has no failure case for obtaining the final price; principle P3 and the gap checklist (Strapi unavailable) require a controlled, announced message with recovery instead of a broken step.

The story allows changing the choice but not what happens when choices are made faster than prices arrive; the gap checklist requires handling repeated actions so the price shown always belongs to the chosen plan.

The story says the person can move on after choosing but not what happens when they try without a choice or before the final price exists; the gap checklist requires the error case, and it mirrors the owner's answer Q2 of CHG-001 (disabled style, still focusable).
The story does not cover repeated activation of continue; the gap checklist requires handling double submission, as AC-021 does for the form steps.

The story does not say whether the choice survives going back, going forward or reloading; the architecture keeps the chosen plan in the per-country wizard store mirrored to session storage, and the gap checklist requires stating these navigations.

The story bases the final price on step 1 data but does not say what happens when that data changes after a plan is chosen; without a rule the person could reach the summary with a price computed from old data.

The business team can deactivate or unpublish plans at any time (BR-02), but the story does not say what happens to a choice stored for a plan that is no longer offered; AC-025 sets the same reconciliation for form data.

The story does not cover entering the plan step or the summary step directly; the gap checklist requires stating direct entry, and AC-024 already leads to the first incomplete step, which now needs a definition of a complete plan step.

CHG-001 (AC-033, AC-034) asks before unconfirmed values are lost; the story does not say whether a chosen plan counts as such. Storing the choice when made means the plan step never asks, and this criterion states it.

The story has no loading, unavailable or invalid state for plans; the architecture loads plans with the country's content, and principle P3 and the engineering reference require explicit, controlled states (AC-015 to AC-017).

The story has no accessibility criteria; principle P6 and the design reference require programmatic names, announced states, color never the only signal for the recommended and chosen plan, and an automated scan.
The story has no accessibility criteria; the design reference requires keyboard-only completion with visible focus and no traps, checked in every user interface review.
The story has no responsive criteria; the design reference sets plan cards side by side on desktop and stacked on mobile, the reference widths, reflow to 320 px and the minimum target size.
The story has no motion criteria; the design reference requires respecting the reduced-motion preference.

The story needs plans and a final price from Strapi but says nothing about access; principle P4 and the architecture limit the public role to read actions on wizard content types plus the custom endpoints, with no token in the browser.
